sql:
SELECT repo_full_name AS repo, COUNT(*) AS nSkills, SUM(content IS NOT NULL AND length(content) > 0) AS nTextSkills,
            SUM(content IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(content, ' ' || char(9) || char(10) || char(13))) > 0) AS nNonBlank
       FROM artifacts
      GROUP BY repo_full_name
      ORDER BY repo_full_name
rows: per-repo counts in analysis/cache/<sha256(sql)>.json (15-20 MB, derived)
